note: The page's own reading of which outcomes each leaf still faces, and line 6 per leaf. Editorial: decision 5. regulatory.json is never edited by the game. Line 6 uses one standard for every leaf: firm when rules or agencies aim at the leaf's main danger, yielding when no lever is known to work against it; every line 6 is turning, because 'aimed at' is not 'shown to work' and this reading could change. The race sits under every branch, so every leaf faces it.

if_no_data.text: targeted: rules on the books aim at misuse; none is shown to stop it, and open weights may put the capability beyond any gatekeeper

line6.why: Rules on the books aim at misuse, and misuse can at least be looked for, so a rule has something to act on. None is shown to stop it.
line6.turn: if the rules aimed at misuse proved not to stop it, for example once the capability is out as open weights

regulate.gloss: A leaky cage: it does what its holders want, so govern the holders and the use.

if_no_data.text: weakly targeted: misuse is targeted; concentration of power only weakly, and some safety ideas (licensing, a single international lab) may add to it

line6.why: Rules aim at misuse; concentration of power is only weakly targeted, and some safety ideas may concentrate power further.
line6.turn: if governing the holders proved out of reach, since no idea on the list is built mainly to prevent concentration of power

contain.gloss: Untrusted, caged: use it only through the bars, and only while they hold.

if_no_data.text: uncertainty: no known mechanism; rules ask for disclosure and testing, but a system that deceives can pass any test that only watches how it behaves

line6.why: Rules aimed at deception exist (disclosure, testing, incident reports), but they rely on watching behaviour, and a deceiving system can behave well while watched. No lever is known to work.
line6.turn: if a way were shown to tell a system that behaves well from one that only acts it

if_no_data.text: uncertainty: no known mechanism; the ways to stop exist as proposals and papers

line6.why: The ways to stop exist as proposals and papers; none is law, and none has been tried.
line6.turn: if a way to stop became law among the main builders, and held
